summary: The foreign private issuer filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a $10 million registered direct offering of 9.3 million Class A ordinary shares at $0.20 per share and pre-funded warrants for 40.7 million shares at $0.1999 per warrant. The offering closed June 16, 2026, and proceeds are for working capital. Directors, officers, and >10% shareholders entered 45-day lock-up agreements. This is a routine capital raise, not a special-situation event.
